ns2:section.sectionText: This course was previously offered as IS 390 CC (STUDENTS WILL NOT RECEIVE CREDIT FOR BOTH). Restricted to Information Sciences major initially. Sophomore standing or above. INFO Minors may register starting by noon 7/6/2021. Restrictions lifted by noon 7/20/2021. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
